transcription.text: Page 2. Unit 1. What can you do with your five senses?
A. Listen, then point and say.
I can touch. I can feel.
I can touch and feel with my hands and fingers.
I can see. I can hear.
I can see and hear with my eyes and ears.
I can smell. I can taste.
I can smell and taste with my nose and tongue.
The Blind Men and the Elephant
1. Four blind men sit under a tree.
